dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, scalloped perimeters of closed and semi-closed 'O' and 'C' shaped structures. The transition is characterized by a sharp gradient from dark charcoal/black exterior pixels to light grey-white interior pixels, visible primarily along the mid-lateral and cervical regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of asymmetrical, high-intensity white pixel clusters located both independently along the dorsal ridge and as central cores within the larger macro-annuli. Core pixel concentration is highest in the cervical-dorsal transition area.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli on the lateral flank form an obtuse scalene triangle. A secondary geometric alignment is formed by a linear series of four high-intensity blobs running parallel to the dorsal-lateral curvature toward the posterior region.
